text.p: These are the leading stories in the Zambian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Leader of the opposition National Party, Humphrey Mulemba, has resigned. Mulemba served in several senior cabinet and ruling party positions under former president Kenneth Kaunda and incumbent President Frederick Chiluba before joining opposition ranks.
- Floods damaged water and sewer pipes and swept away a bridge in the southern town of Maamba.
- Three soldiers were killed and 19 others were injured when they were hit by a bus early on Monday.
- Lecturers at the state-run National Resources Development College began a go-slow strike on Monday to push for better service conditions.
